modmenu.descriptionTranslation.bloodmoon: Hostile mobs spawn with levels: the farther from spawn and the older the world, the stronger they are and the better their loot. With affixed champions, stampedes, blood moons and zone bosses. Server-side: vanilla clients can join.
bloodmoonandbosses.jefe.onda: The boss is charging a shockwave: get away!
bloodmoonandbosses.jefe.tiron: The boss is about to pull you in: hold on!
bloodmoonandbosses.luna.fin: Dawn: the blood moon is over
bloodmoonandbosses.estampida.ya_hay: there is already a stampede against %s
bloodmoonandbosses.estampida.sin_mundo: the player is not in a server world
bloodmoonandbosses.estampida.sin_lugar: there is no room around %s for the stampede
bloodmoonandbosses.zona.nivel: Mobs in this zone spawn at level %s
bloodmoonandbosses.zona.detalle: (%s from distance and +%s from the world's %s days)
bloodmoonandbosses.zona.campeon: . One in %s is a champion with +%s
bloodmoonandbosses.zona.luna: . There is a blood moon: mobs spawning tonight get +%s
bloodmoonandbosses.comando.sin_nivel: That entity can't have a level
bloodmoonandbosses.comando.jefe_sin_luga: There is no room near %s for a boss (or this dimension's tag is empty)
bloodmoonandbosses.comando.luna_de_dia: The blood moon can only start at night (try /time set night)
bloodmoonandbosses.comando.luna: The blood moon started: it lasts until dawn
bloodmoonandbosses.comando.recarga_falli: Couldn't read the config, keeping the previous one: %s
bloodmoonandbosses.comando.recargada: Config reloaded. Mobs that were already around keep their stats and gear
config.jade.plugin_bloodmoonandbosses.al: How far Jade shows mobs, in blocks. 0 leaves Jade's own range
bloodmoonandbosses.config.pantalla.servi: You're connected to a server: this changes %s on this installation, not the server's.
bloodmoonandbosses.config.pantalla.no_se: Not saved, the file was left as it was:
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.bloquesP: Every how many blocks from spawn mobs gain a level
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.variacio: How many levels above or below its zone a mob can be
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.diasPorN: Every how many world days spawning mobs gain a level. 0 turns it off
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.chanceDe: From 0 to 1: 0.05 is one in 20 mobs
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.escalarS: Off keeps spawner farms as in vanilla
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.vidaEnEl: Whether the mob's name shows its health (❤ 34/40)
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.porNivel: What each level adds. Percentages as a fraction: 0.08 = +8%
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.tope: The most it can add, in the same unit as «Per level»
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.nivelRad: From which level creeper explosions are bigger
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.nivelesP: Every how many levels the material improves: leather, chain or gold, iron, diamond, netherite
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.cascoPar: Whether zombies and skeletons can get helmets: if on, they survive the sun
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.poderDeE: The level their gear is enchanted at, like the enchanting table's
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.chanceTi: Only for mobs in the tiradas_extra_por_chance tag (evokers)
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.afijos.c: That a champion has an affix. 0 turns them off
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.curacion: Share of the damage dealt that it heals: 0.5 = half
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.escala: 0.4 = 40% bigger. Bigger mobs don't fit through 2-high tunnels
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.lunaDeSa: For each full moon night, from 0 to 1
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.chanceDe: That a mob spawning alone comes with another one like it
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.segundos: If nobody gets close for this long, it leaves
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.vidaFuri: Fraction of health at which it enrages: 0.5 = half. 0 turns it off
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.danioOnd: In boss hits: 1 = the same as one of its hits
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.contorno: The purple glow (red when enraged) visible through walls
bloodmoonandbosses.config.ayuda.idioma: For mob names seen by players without the mod on their client, and for the console
